fields.description: Issue includes local court and public-safety reporting (including remarks attributed to Judge Curry and accounts of liquor-related offenses and drunk-driving cases), a report on a downtown power blackout affecting the county courthouse, and extensive coverage alleging abusive psychiatric practices involving Dr. Moore and Rev. Joseph Barth, including pills/capsules, hypnosis, and attempted shock treatment. Also includes nightlife and entertainment columns and advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach clubs and restaurants, and a column discussing a religious radio program (“The Greatest Story Ever Told”).
